physics.scope: Within each native GIZMO variant, actual historical tanh versus sharp velocity. Regular equal-volume initial lattice, variable masses, original float32 IC/output precision and fully periodic native boundary recipe. Native kernel-derived density/pressure must be checked separately. No passive material tracer is assumed; particle-ID mass in MFV is not a material-retention diagnostic.

mass_account.criterion: Predeclared engineering accumulation gate, not a physical accuracy theorem.

mass_comparison.method: Native-time curves; peak uses explicit linear scalar interpolation onto0:0.05:5tcc. No3Dframe interpolation.
mass_comparison.interpretation: One coarse L3 within-code sensitivity, not exact-solution error or convergence.

limitations: One coarse initial64x32x32 lattice; finer resolution not validated.
Old failed uninitialized-timestep MFV controls remain excluded.
Native velocities are staggered; no simultaneous velocity diagnostics.
Periodic boundaries and kernel-pressure deviations retained; no cross-code equality.
No passive material-retention diagnostic, cooling or frame tracking.
Validated analysis is not new production3Dviewer entries or a raw backup.
